functions.name: count_item
functions.description: Counts occurrences of a given item definition ID in the innkeeper's inventory.

functions.name: has_item
functions.description: Returns true if the innkeeper has at least one of the specified item.

functions.name: low_stock
functions.description: Determines if any drink type has less than three units in stock.

functions.name: restock_drinks
functions.description: Resets drinks up to five units each when low stock is detected. Returns true if restocking occurred.

functions.name: sell_drinks
functions.description: Attempts to sell an available drink to nearby eligible entities. Returns true on successful sale.

functions.name: buy_tankards
functions.description: Purchases a tankard from nearby merchant entities. Returns true when a tankard is bought.

functions.name: clean_up
functions.description: Performs periodic cleaning actions, logging and setting mood every 50 ticks.

functions.name: do_tick
functions.description: Main update loop called each game tick; handles night behavior, restocking, trading, movement, and cleanup.

functions.name: get_patrol_route
functions.description: Retrieves the guard's patrol route configuration.

functions.name: should_return_home
functions.description: Determines if the guard should head back to its home location.

functions.name: attack_hostiles
functions.description: Attempts to attack nearby hostile entities.

functions.name: do_patrol
functions.description: Executes one step of the guard's patrol behavior.

functions.name: maybe_drink
functions.description: Random chance for the guard to drink a beverage.

functions.name: update_mood
functions.description: Updates the guard's mood based on recent actions.

functions.name: do_tick
functions.description: Main tick function for the guard AI, coordinating patrol, combat, and morale.

functions.name: pick_next_destination
functions.description: Selects the next location the salesman will travel to.

functions.name: try_trade
functions.description: Attempts a trade interaction with a specified target entity.

functions.name: do_trade
functions.description: Performs trade actions for the current tick.

functions.name: do_tick
functions.description: Main update loop for the traveling salesman AI.

functions.name: drag_entity
functions.description: Attempts to leash target entity to dragger; returns true if successful.

functions.name: start_rescue
functions.description: Initiates a rescue mission for target entity by rescuer; returns true if mission started.

functions.name: complete_rescue
functions.description: Marks the rescue as completed and awards rewards to rescuer.

event_hooks.name: onSpawn
event_hooks.description: Called when an entity is created in the world.

event_hooks.name: onDeath
event_hooks.description: Called when an entity dies or is removed.

event_hooks.name: onQuestStart
event_hooks.description: Triggered when a quest begins for an entity.

event_hooks.name: onQuestComplete
event_hooks.description: Triggered when a quest is successfully finished.

event_hooks.name: onLocationChange
event_hooks.description: Fires whenever an entity changes its location.

event_hooks.name: onRescueStart
event_hooks.description: Fires when a rescue mission is started for a target entity.

event_hooks.name: onRescueComplete
event_hooks.description: Fires when a rescue mission successfully completes.

event_hooks.name: onDragStart
event_hooks.description: Fires when an entity begins dragging another entity (e.g., leashed dog).

functions.name: init_quest
functions.description: Initialises quest state for the given entity.

functions.name: progress_quest
functions.description: Advances the quest to the next step; returns true if successful.

functions.name: complete_quest
functions.description: Marks the quest as completed for the entity.

functions.name: init_rescue
functions.description: Sets up a rescue quest for rescuer to save target.

functions.name: progress_rescue
functions.description: Updates rescue progress (e.g., after dragging).

functions.name: complete_rescue_quest
functions.description: Finalises the rescue quest and grants rewards.
